clips.title: The story
paras: Boulderslide Ravine is a rugged, secluded canyon tucked away in the central peaks of the Stonetalon Mountains, reached via Webwinder Path. Largely spared from the direct clashes between the Horde and Alliance, it serves as the rocky approach to Boulderslide Cavern and remains home to wild mountain beasts.

Tucked away off Webwinder Path, Boulderslide Ravine is a narrow cut of rock in the Stonetalon heights. While loggers, night elves, and the Horde battle over timber and sacred glades throughout the region, this craggy pass remains relatively undisturbed by military forces. Wild mountain rams and roaming crag beasts like Cliff Stormers make up the local fauna, navigating the treacherous ledges and sheer stone walls. Prospectors also keep an eye on the ravine, as rich mineral veins frequently crop up along the rocky slopes leading deeper toward the cavern network.
